06001.name: Alameda County
06001.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Under a county agreement running 7/1/2025 to 6/30/2031, with a five-year service period starting 7/1/2026, AMR West holds the emergency ambulance area covering all cities and unincorporated areas except Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Piedmont and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory. The fire departments of Alameda, Albany, Berkeley and Piedmont run their own emergency ambulance areas, and the laboratory is served by Alameda County Fire. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the state EMS authority's January 2026 list still names Falck, and no source dated after the July 1, 2026 start says the change.

06003.name: Alpine County
06003.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names Alpine County EMS for the whole county. Not yet confirmed from a county page, or who covers Kirkwood and Bear Valley.

06005.name: Amador County
06005.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names American Legion Ambulance for all of Amador County. Not yet confirmed from a county or regional EMS agency page.

06007.name: Butte County

06007.note: Butte County EMS holds the county's exclusive 911 ambulance area. Chico, Oroville and Paradise fire departments respond but do not transport.

06011.name: Colusa County
06011.via: EMSA Ambulance Areas/EOA Status (rev. 1/14/2026) + LEMSA plans, county board items (local sources)
06011.note: American Medical Response holds Colusa County's exclusive 911 ambulance area (agreement 2023). The City of Colusa Fire Department responds to medical calls but its page describes engine-based care, not ambulance transport.

06013.name: Contra Costa County
06013.via: EMSA Ambulance Areas/EOA Status (rev. 1/14/2026) + LEMSA plans, county board items (local sources)
06013.note: Five emergency response areas cover the county: Contra Costa County Fire (with AMR as its subcontractor), Moraga-Orinda Fire District and San Ramon Valley Fire District.

06015.name: Del Norte County
06015.via: EMSA Ambulance Areas/EOA Status (rev. 1/14/2026) + LEMSA plans, county board items (local sources)

06037.name: Los Angeles County
06037.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. AMR serves the county's Area 1; Care Ambulance serves Areas 2-5; McCormick Ambulance serves Areas 6-9, per the state EMS authority's January 2026 list of 34 zones. About 24 city fire departments, including Los Angeles (also San Fernando), Long Beach, Glendale, Pasadena, Santa Monica and Torrance, run their own ambulances. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the county EMS agency's own list of providers.

06043.name: Mariposa County
06043.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names Mercy Medical Transport for all of Mariposa County. Not yet confirmed: a county source, and whether Yosemite National Park's own ambulance transports from the park.

06047.name: Merced County
06047.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Merced County changed its 911 ambulance contractor from Riggs Ambulance (Sierra Medical Services Alliance) to AMR around January 2026. West Side Community Ambulance, based in Newman, also serves part of Merced County. Not yet confirmed: a county or state source after the change naming AMR, and which area West Side covers.

06057.note: Sierra Nevada Ambulance serves western Nevada County (Grass Valley, Nevada City, south to the Placer line); Penn Valley Fire serves Penn Valley and Lake Wildwood; Truckee Fire serves Truckee and Donner Summit.

06059.name: Orange County
06059.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names Orange County Fire Authority Regions A-E (Emergency Ambulance Service, Care) and city ambulance areas served by Care, Huntington Beach Fire, Newport Beach Fire, Orange Fire, La Habra, Doctor's Ambulance (Laguna Beach) and San Clemente city/Orange County Fire Authority. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the county EMS agency's own list, or any city changes since 2024.

06065.name: Riverside County
06065.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names AMR (7 zones), Riverside County Fire/CAL FIRE (Cove Cities, Indio), Cathedral City Fire, Idyllwild Fire Protection District and Blythe Ambulance. AMR's contract was set to expire June 30, 2026, and extensions were denied (Idyllwild Town Crier, Nov 2023). Not yet confirmed from a public source: who provides service after July 2026.

06067.name: Sacramento County
06067.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list shows one non-exclusive county zone whose licensees (including Alpha One, AMR, Bay Medic, CHP and CALSTAR) are not 911 transporters. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the fire departments that provide 911 transport (Sacramento Fire, Sacramento Metro Fire, Cosumnes, Folsom and others), which need a Sacramento County EMS source.

06071.name: San Bernardino County
06071.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list shows 26 areas. The Unified Area (exclusive areas 1-4) is marked 'HOLD until contract received', and area 26 (Havasu Lake) shows 'No approved provider'. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who serves those areas.

06073.name: San Diego County
06073.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names providers for 30 of the county's 31 areas: Falck for the City of San Diego; AMR for CSA-17, El Cajon, Grossmont and National City; San Diego County Fire Protection District for the inland areas; the fire departments of Carlsbad, Chula Vista, Coronado, Escondido, Oceanside, Poway, San Marcos, Vista and Santee/Lakeside; North County Fire Protection District; and tribal and Department of Defense areas. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the Harmony Grove Service Area, listed only as 'closest available resource', and the county EMS agency's own list.

06077.name: San Joaquin County
06077.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. CENCAL Fire and EMS Authority holds the exclusive emergency ambulance contract for Zones X and Y, May 1, 2026 to May 1, 2031 (county Board of Supervisors, Feb 10, 2026). Other zones per the state EMS authority's January 2026 list: Manteca District Ambulance (Zone D), Ripon Fire Protection District (E) and Escalon Community Ambulance (F). Not yet confirmed from a public source: Zone Y boundaries and any other zones; the state list still shows AMR for Zone X (Lodi).

06081.name: San Mateo County
06081.via: EMSA Ambulance Areas/EOA Status (rev. 1/14/2026) + LEMSA plans, county board items (local sources)
06081.note: AMR holds the county-wide exclusive 911 ambulance contract except South San Francisco, where South San Francisco Fire transports. Other fire agencies give paramedic first response only.

A county request for proposals for a new exclusive ambulance contract was in draft in July 2026. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the county EMS agency's own list.

06095.name: Solano County
06095.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. The state EMS authority's January 2026 list names Medic Ambulance for the county except the Vacaville area, and Vacaville Fire Department for Vacaville and the surrounding unincorporated area. The contract is on short extensions, and a new request for proposals with a Fairfield/Medic joint bid is in progress (Daily Republic). 06109.note: Unverified lead, not yet independently checked. Tuolumne County picked Mercy Medical Transportation in April 2026 to replace Tuolumne County Ambulance Service (run by Manteca District Ambulance since 1987) after June 30, 2026. Not yet confirmed: a source after the handover saying Mercy now runs 911 ambulances.

06111.name: Ventura County
06111.via: EMSA Ambulance Areas/EOA Status (rev. 1/14/2026) + LEMSA plans, county board items (local sources)
06111.note: Seven exclusive ambulance areas cover the county: Gold Coast Ambulance runs areas 1 and 6, AMR runs areas 2-5 and 7, and Ventura County Fire rescue ambulances run under subcontract. A county bid for future providers is in preparation.

06115.name: Yuba County
